description: USD price of any Arc token: read live from the Uniswap v4 pool state across its USDC pools (our index of every v4 pool on Arc), deepest hookless pool preferred. Returns usdPrice, the pool used, liquidityUsdEstimate, block and warnings (hook, thin). No USDC pool or a failed read is refused before payment. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_price
